services.desc: You can visit our contact page for immediate help as well. We have a full team standing by to answer you calls, e-mails and texts. Sorry about my delay in reports. We only fished a few days this week till the winds blew up on us and it looks like they are here for a while. normal for this time of year I guess though anyways. Capt Joe and Capt Ricky were both able to get offshore... Mahi and sharks are the theme of the week. Actually had more mahi than kings this week. Water out to 220 has been an odd color of black. Black mixed with some brown in it. Almost like Okeechobee cyprus black. Very odd. Hopefully this week of wind blows it out of... What a great week we had. Solid fishing every
